select t.name as testName, s.student_no as studentNo, st.name as studentName, st.major_name as majorName, st.class_no as classCo, s.total as totalScore from score s left join test t on s.test_no = t.id left join student st on s.student_no = st.student_no where 1 = 1
and st.major_name like concat('%', #{majorName}, '%')
and st.name like concat('%', #{studentName}, '%')
and (st.class_no like concat('%', #{classCo}, '%') or st.class_name like concat('%', #{classCo}, '%'))
and s.student_no like concat('%', #{studentNo}, '%')
order by s.id desc
select max(s.total) as maxScore, min(s.total) as minScore, ifnull(avg(s.total), 0) as averageScore from score s where s.test_no = #{testNo}
select count(1) from score s left join test t on s.test_no = t.id where s.test_no = #{testNo} and s.total >= (ifnull(t.total_score, 0) * 0.6)

select s.id as scoreId, s.test_no as testNo, t.name as testName, s.choice as choiceScore, s.subjective as subjectiveScore, s.total as totalScore, s.create_time as createTime from score s left join test t on s.test_no = t.id where s.student_no = #{studentNo} order by s.id desc
